description: Browse or fetch capability descriptors (keys, modes, schemas). Use hydracept_resolve_capability when routing from intent alone. List/resolve is keyless; a bearer key may add project-scoped fields. No charge. Read-only. Returns: Capability list or single CapabilityDescriptor when key is set. Errors: NOT_FOUND for unknown key; INVALID_ARGUMENT for conflicting query parameters.

key.description: Optional capability key for GET /v1/capabilities/{key}. When set, query is ignored.
key.title: Key

query.description: Optional search string when key is empty. Hosted: always POST /v1/capabilities/resolve (keyless). Stdio: resolve when authenticated, else list filtering.
query.title: Query

name: hydracept_capabilities
title: List capabilities
